stories.title: Mayor Patkotak reelected in North Slope Borough
stories.summary: Five assembly members and four school board members elected

stories.title: Kotzebue residents tell AIDEA the Ambler Road could bring safety and environmental problems, and too few jobs
stories.summary: Others told the board Red Dog’s success has come at a cost, pointing to the mine’s 52-mile haul road.

stories.title: Weekend storm prompts temporary, mass evacuation in Kivalina
stories.summary: According to the Northwest Arctic Borough School District, 202 people sheltered at the school over the weekend.

stories.title: Shungnak man charged with assault after nonlethal shooting
stories.summary: Troopers found Foster asleep in woods near the airport, carrying a loaded handgun and was arrested without incident, according to court documents.

stories.title: ‘We should not have to choose’: Alaska Native education specialists say culture and academics go together
stories.summary: The education panel was one of many discussions and workshops held at the Elders and Youth Conference in Anchorage in October

stories.title: Traveling by boat and snowmachine, this Yup’ik grandmother promotes voting in remote Alaska villages
stories.summary: According to Get Out the Native Vote, a nonprofit working to increase voting in Alaska Native communities, turnout in the Northwest Arctic peaked near 80% in 1982, the year subsistence was on the statewide ballot. In 2024, the borough’s turnout was less than half that.

stories.title: Solar farm planned for Red Dog Mine would be the largest in Alaska
stories.summary: According to plans filed with the state, the solar farm will have more than 15,000 panels on about 30 acres, an area about the size of 23 football fields.

stories.title: Selawik man charged after cocaine found in cooler bound for Kotzebue
stories.summary: Walter Lee Berry is charged with one count of misconduct involving a controlled substance, a felony. If convicted, he faces up to 10 years in prison and a $100,000 fine.

stories.title: AFN honors Kotzebue National Guard member who led local responses after devastating storms
stories.summary: In October, a year after Halong, the Alaska Federation of Natives honored Woods with its Gin’tith Richard Frank Military Award, for his service helping Western Alaska recover from the devastating storms.

stories.title: Lawsuit over Arctic offshore oil prospect says resurrection of leases was illegal
stories.summary: The lawsuit, filed in federal court, targets the Trump administration’s decision to give Hilcorp more time to plan its development of the Liberty prospect in federal waters of the Beaufort Sea

stories.title: Museum swap brings bones of hero dog back to Alaska
stories.summary: A trade with Yale’s Peabody Museum has sent the remains of Togo, a legendary lead dog in the 1925 Serum Run, to the University of Alaska Museum of the North

stories.title: Trump plans separate talks with Putin alongside their summit with Xi in China
stories.summary: The president’s meeting with Putin would be the first time the leaders have held talks since their discussions last year in Alaska that failed to broker a deal to ease Russia’s war in Ukraine.
